derivation.deletion_operation: Delete exactly the listed whole owner, retaining all other complete SNC owners in the parent frame. The deleted owner attains a parent host wall. Initialize with the listed parent centers at retained_indices, retain realized pair separators and restore all38 common host walls. Continue only pair-separator changes realized at the previous complete state.
derivation.pair_normal_semantics: Rational direction proposals; supports are recomputed from exact canonical vertices.
derivation.source_lattice: For a lattice parent, B=2R*[[1,0,1/2],[0,0,1/y-1],[0,1,-1/2]], where y^3+y^2+y=1 and R is the canonical square-face radius; initial centers B*word-B*phase_word/2.
derivation.source_TCO_inclusion: For a TCO parent, replace each complete beta-scaled TCO by its contained canonical SNC with beta=2R/(1+2sqrt2); preserve every source quaternion.
derivation.native_decoder: Stored centers are binary64 rounding of returned centers times(1+1e-7), all with identity quaternion. s_full is nextafter(nominal*(1+1e-7)+1e-7,+infinity). Stored numbers are exact rational inputs for complete native interval verification.

source.attribution_note: The classical source lattice and any intermediate donor are retained in the parent decoder. PingYou Ltd supplies the new finite whole-owner deletion return.
